summary: Identifies the metering boundary used to distinguish generation, load, import and storage energy.
description: Identifies the metering boundary used to distinguish generation, load, import and storage energy. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Named energy measurements” at the input and “Separated energy quantities” at the output. Metering and control boundaries can differ.
